title: Kyber, ukukhishwa kwenguqulo 0.27
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Sikhipha inguqulo yethu 0.27, eneziguquko ezinkulu ezi-3: ibhodi lokukopisha elithuthukisiwe, ukungena nge-OpenID Connect, nepayipi lemidiya elisebenza kangcono. Kukhona nokulungiswa okuncane okuningi.
html:
Kyber 0.27!

I-Kyber 0.27 isiphumile.

Lokhu kukhishwa kugxile ekusakazeni kumaklayenti amaningi: manje abantu abaningana bangaxhuma kumsingathi ofanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa. Iklayenti lewebhu nalo selilingana namanye ekuqinisekiseni ubunikazi nge-OIDC. Selinegrafu ebonisa ukubambezeleka ngesikhathi sangempela, futhi womabili amaklayenti asekuvumela ukuthi uzikhethele ukuthi azixhume kabusha yini ngokwawo.

Nakhu okugqame kakhulu.

Abantu abaningi, umshini owodwa

Kuze kube manje, umsingathi we-Kyber ubusebenzela iklayenti elilodwa ngesikhathi. Ku-0.27 usebenzela wonke amaklayenti owaxhuma kuwo.

Iqhinga lilapha: umsingathi usathwebula futhi ufaka ikhodi kwisikrini ngasinye kanye kuphela. Lowo mthombo owodwa ubese ukopishwa unikezwe wonke umuntu obukayo. Ngakho umbukeli wesibili noma wesithathu cishe akabizi lutho kumsingathi mayelana ne-GPU noma i-CPU. Ongena phakathi nesikhathi uthola ifreyimu eyinhloko entsha lapho efika. Ngale ndlela iwindi lakhe ligcwala isithombe ngokushesha, kunokuba libonise udoti kuze kufike ifreyimu eyinhloko elandelayo ngokwemvelo yayo.

Lokhu kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma ufuna ukubuyela endleleni yakudala, lapho kuvunyelwa iklayenti elilodwa bese bonke abanye benqatshwa, setha `multi_client = false` esigabeni esithi `[kycontroller]` sefayela `kyber_config.toml`. Lapho-ke umuntu wesibili ozama ukungena uzonqatshwa ngomlayezo ocacile, kunokuba ajoyine buthule.

Kunezinto ezimbili okufanele uzazi ngaphambi kokuthembela kulokhu. Okokuqala, iklayenti lokuqala ukuxhuma yilo elinquma izilungiselelo zokusakaza. Ngakho iklayenti elifika kamuva licela ikhodeki ehlukile noma izinga lebhithi elihlukile, lizothola lokho okucelwe yiklayenti lokuqala. Okwesibili, ingemuva elidala le-RTP alitholakali kwimodi yokwabelana.

Ngena ngomqulu wenkampani yakho (OIDC), esipheqululini

I-0.26 yaletha i-OIDC kwiklayenti ledeskithophu nakuseva. I-0.27 isiyiletha nasesipheqululini.

Khetha i-OIDC njengendlela yokuqinisekisa ubunikazi, uchofoze ithi Xhuma, bese umhlinzeki wobunikazi bakho ethatha izintambo. Lokhu kungaba yi-Keycloak, i-Auth0, i-Authelia, noma yimuphi omunye osebenzisa leli zinga elijwayelekile. Ngokuzenzakalelayo kuvuleka ewindini eliqhamukayo. Uma ususa uphawu ebhokisini, uzothola ukuqondiswa kabusha kwekhasi eliphelele. Lapho ubuya, izilungiselelo zakho zokuqala zisaphelele futhi kuyazixhuma ngokwakho. Ithokheni iyazivuselela cishe umzuzu owodwa ngaphambi kokuthi iphelelwe yisikhathi. Ngakho iseshini ende ayiphazamiseki phakathi nendawo.

Kanti ukubambezeleka kwami kuphumaphi ngempela?

Isikhalazo esithi “Kuyanensa” kunzima ukusilungisa. Manje iklayenti lewebhu selingakuphendula lokho.

Vula izilinganiso ngaphambi kokuxhuma. Ibha eseceleni izobe isikukhombisa igrafu yesikhathi sangempela yazo zonke izigaba ifreyimu edlula kuzo, kusukela lapho ithwetshulwa khona kumsingathi kuze kube iboniswa esipheqululini sakho. Ngaphezu kwayo kukhona isibalo sokubambezeleka okuphelele, esihlukaniswe izingxenye ezintathu: isikhathi esichithwe kuseva, isikhathi enethiwekhini, nesikhathi esipheqululini sakho. Uma isibalo senethiwekhi sisikhulu kunazo zonke, inkinga isekuxhumaneni kwakho. Uma esiseva sisikhulu kunazo zonke, inkinga isesifakini-khodi somsingathi. Uma esiklayenti sisikhulu kunazo zonke, umshini wakho uyasokola ukuqaqa ikhodi.

Izigaba ngazinye zingavulwa noma zivalwe. Igrafu ingakhishwa futhi ebheni eseceleni ibe yisendlalelo esintantayo phezu kwevidiyo. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba iyithuluzi lokuhlola izinkinga, hhayi into odinga ukuyisebenzisa nsuku zonke.

Ukuxhuma kabusha sekukhethwa nguwe

Sekuyisikhathi womabili amaklayenti ezama kabusha ngokwawo lapho ukuxhumana kunqamuka. Enza imizamo eyishumi, umzuzwana owodwa phakathi komzamo nomzamo, futhi isimo sibonisa ukuthi sekungumzamo wesingaki.

Lokho kuseyindlela ezenzakalelayo, futhi kuseyikho okufunayo esikhathini esiningi. Okusha yinkinobho yokukuvala. Iklayenti ledeskithophu lamukela i-`--auto-reconnect=false`. Iklayenti lewebhu linebhokisi lokumaka elithi Xhuma kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo, esigabeni Sokuxhuma sebha eseceleni. Esikhumulweni sokuzisebenzela somphakathi, esikrinini sokubonisa, noma ekuhloleni okulawulwa yiskripthi, iklayenti eliqhubeka lizama buthule lifihla inkinga yangempela. Manje selingehluleka ngokusobala.

Ukukopisha nokunamathisela nemisingathi ye-Linux

I-0.26 yanika iklayenti le-Linux ingxenye yalo yokwesekwa kwebhodi lokukopisha. Ingxenye yomsingathi yayingekho. Ngakho ukukopisha umbhalo kudeskithophu ye-Linux ekude kwakungenzi lutho neze.

Leso sikhala sesivaliwe. Umbhalo ongenalutho kanye ne-HTML manje kudlula ezinhlangothini zombili nemisingathi ye-X11, njengoba bekuvele kwenzeka ku-Windows. Abaphathi abafuna ukuvumela uhlangothi olulodwa kuphela bangakukhawulela lokho kumsingathi ngamunye kuzilungiselelo.

Izilawuli zemidlalo seziphinde zasebenza kahle kwimisingathi ye-Windows

Ushintsho lwangaphambilini lwenza ukuthi isilawuli semidlalo esibonakalayo se-Kyber sibikele umsingathi we-Windows izinombolo zokuhlonza ze-USB zesilawuli sangempela. Umqondo kwakungukuthi imidlalo izosibona kangcono. Lokho akwenzekanga. I-DualSense yayicindezela izinkinobho ngokwayo kungekho muntu ozicindezele. Izilawuli ze-Xbox ezintsha kune-360 zayeka nokusebenza ngokuphelele lapho uxhuma usuka kudeskithophu ye-Linux noma esipheqululini.

Lolo shintsho seluhoxisiwe. Umsingathi uphinde wabona isilawuli esijwayelekile se-Xbox 360 noma i-DualShock 4 ejwayelekile, okuyizinto ezaziwa yikho konke.

Ukulungiswa kokuthembeka

kycontroller: Umsingathi akasaphoqi ukuthi ifayela lakhe lezilungiselelo libe eduze nefayela lakhe elisebenzisekayo. I-`kycontroller --config /etc/kyber/kyber_config.toml` imqondisa ngqo efayeleni. I-`KYBER_CONFIG` yenza okufanayo ngemvelo yesistimu. Inqubo yokuqala ukuyixazulula idlulisela phansi indlela ephelele. Ngakho isilawuli, iseva yokuthwebula neseva yokufaka bonke bafunda ifayela elilodwa, kunokuba ngamunye azingele elakhe. I-`KYBER_LOG_DIR` ibeka amalogi endaweni engabhalwa kuyo. Futhi isilungiselelo esisha esithi `webclient` sinikeza iklayenti lesiphequluli lisuka kufolda ozikhethele yona. Uma ubhala indlela ngephutha, i-Kyber manje iyama ngephutha, kunokuba iqale buthule ngezilungiselelo ezizenzakalelayo. Lokho kwakubukeka ncamashi njengokuthi “izilungiselelo zami ziyashaywa indiva”.

kyservice: Ku-Windows, isevisi esebenza ngemuva eqalisa umsingathi eseshini yakho yedeskithophu yayinikeza i-Windows isikhombi senkumbulo eyayisivele iyikhululile. Uphawu lwakhona kwakuwumsingathi owawehluleka ukuqala ngezikhathi ezithile ngemuva kokuqalisa ikhompyutha noma ukuqalisa kabusha isevisi, kungekho okubonakalayo ongakukhomba njengenkinga. Sekulungisiwe.

kyclient: Iklayenti lalijwayele ukushiya iwindi lalo livulekile lithi “lilinde ukuxhuma kabusha” ngisho noma selivele liyekile ukuzama. Lokho kwakukushiya ubuka ifreyimu yokugcina eqandayo eyayingasoze yabuya. Manje liyavaleka lapho iseshini isiphele ngempela, futhi imizamo yangempela liyibika njengemizamo.

libkypc: Izinqubo ezisizayo manje zibulawa ngokushesha lapho umsingathi eyeka isibambo sazo. Izinqubo zokuthwebula ezisele zodwa, ezisabambe isikrini nesifaki-khodi se-GPU ngemuva kokuphela kweseshini, kufanele sezibe yinto yesikhathi esedlule.

Buyekeza

I-Kyber 0.27 isiyatholakala manje.

Vakashela ikhasi lokulanda ukuze uthole inguqulo yakamuva, noma udonse amaphakheji abuyekeziwe ngomzila wakho ojwayelekile.

Imibono nemibiko yamaphutha yamukelekile endaweni yethu ye-Discord .
